_README: CURATED SAFETY REFERENCE — NOT AN AUTHORITATIVE LIVE FEED. Pakistan's official registered/banned pesticide lists are published by the Department of Plant Protection (DPP) at https://plantprotection.gov.pk/services/pesticide-registration/ as PDF documents, and DPP is being reorganized (see spec Section 4.5). A human must verify and update this file against the current official list before relying on it. The Crop Protection agent uses 'banned' only to REFUSE suggestions; it does not claim anything is 'approved' on its own authority.
source_note: Curated reference list — pending official DPP verification (last edited by developer).

disclaimer.en: This is general guidance only. Confirm the exact product, dose, and safety precautions with your nearest agriculture extension office before spraying. Wear protection and follow the label.
disclaimer.ur: یہ صرف عمومی رہنمائی ہے۔ اسپرے سے پہلے صحیح دوا، مقدار اور احتیاطی تدابیر اپنے قریبی زرعی توسیعی دفتر سے ضرور تصدیق کریں۔ حفاظتی لباس پہنیں اور ہدایات پر عمل کریں۔
